'''''Star Wars: Jedi Knights''''' is a [[canon]] [[2025]] ongoing [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series written by [[Marc Guggenheim]] and illustrated by [[Madibek Musabekov]] and [[Luis Guerrero]]. The series takes place before the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], with each issue following two different [[Jedi]] on a different mission with an overarching threat that binds the stories together. The [[Jedi Knights 1|first issue]] was published by [[Marvel Comics]] on [[March 5]], 2025.<ref name="Marvel" /> The series was first pitched by Guggenheim in [[May]] [[2024]]<ref name="Marc">{{Substack|subdomain=marcguggenheim|url=p/year-in-review-24|name=[[Marc Guggenheim]]|username=marcguggenheim|text=YEAR IN REVIEW '24}}</ref> and officially announced on [[October 18]], 2024.<ref name="Marvel" />

While its events can be narrowed down to between the [[Standard year|years]] [[40 BBY]] and [[34 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Guggenheim was purposely vague with what specific years the series took place in, as per the wishes of the [[Lucasfilm Story Group]].<ref name="DateRange">{{Bluesky|marcguggenheim.bsky.social|post/3lqv6bbkn622k|[[Marc Guggenheim]]|date=2025-06-05|quote=Per Story Group, I haven’t been specific about an actual year/period.}}</ref>
